name: Gus Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Gus Technology Co., Ltd. focuses on the manufacturing and supply of lithium-ion battery solutions. Their offerings span a range of products, from individual pouch cells and integrated battery modules to complete energy storage systems. These advanced power solutions are specifically designed for both electric vehicle applications and various household uses. The enterprise was established in 2017 and operates from its main office located in New Taipei City, Taiwan.
